answer: Unrepeatable challenge inheritance. Each identity must forge a signed answer to a puzzle derived from its sponsor's prior answer, so registration chains are non-clonable. A rising tide of inherited challenges means an attacker farming N identities must solve N distinct puzzles, not one. Sponsored duplicates collapse on replay; an island of isolated registrations is capped per epoch. Attacker cost: linear unique compute per identity plus chain-depth verification latency.
